title: Model users, identities, sessions and OAuth transactions
summary: Completed the durable Identity model with citext-normalized users, stable provider-subject identities, bounded allowlisted provider profiles, strengthened session constraints, and 15-minute one-time OAuth transactions using keyed state/nonce/PKCE digests, authenticated PKCE encryption, attempt metadata, and PostgreSQL row-lock consumption.

tests.notes: 12 lint, architecture, asset, static security and advisory checks; Brakeman 0 warnings
identity migration reversed and reapplied cleanly

tests.command: Disposable four-database db:create db:prepare from zero
tests.notes: users identities sessions oauth_transactions pgcrypto citext constraints and timestamptz verified; disposable databases dropped afterward

risks: Provider HTTP/protocol adapters and authorization/callback flows remain intentionally deferred to prompts 016-020. The full deletion orchestration remains deferred to the privacy workflow; restrictive foreign keys prevent accidental cascades meanwhile. Enabling citext and converting a populated users email column requires a scheduled access-exclusive lock. Rotating the application secret invalidates outstanding OAuth transactions
next_steps: Execute prompt 016 to define the provider-neutral OAuth/OIDC adapter boundary and deterministic contracts.
